location_qualifier: Koli Point area; landings in October and on 2–3 November
current_activity: landing further elements, including at Koli Point
notes: Miller, chapter VII: part of the 230th Infantry had already landed in October and on 2–3 November 1942; a small force was landed at Koli Point in early November to supply Shoji’s troops who had retreated there after the October battle. The claim date is 3 November, the last of the dated landing days. Confidence 0.5 (Miller, chapter VII, note 24, cites an Americal intelligence report, not 17th Army Operations, for the landing days).
